notice.text: Weekly workshops run on Thursdays, 18:00 to 19:00, in Building 100, room 3023.

statement: We make AI easy to start for every student at Southampton, then build real things with it together.

about.who: The University of Southampton's AI society: students from every course, run by a student committee. Membership is free through SUSU.
about.what: Weekly workshops, from a first line of Python to diffusion models. Talks from researchers and engineers. Hackathons, and year-long projects like SotonLM.
about.aim: To make AI easy for everyone at Southampton, then give anyone who wants more something real to build.
